verdict: Spend is flowing but outcomes are invisible — tracking gaps make it impossible to judge campaign health.
diagnosis: One Facebook campaign ran this period at $2,330 spend with no lead, conversion, or pipeline data visible to judge results.

signals.headline: $2,330 spent across 28 days
signals.detail: Single Facebook campaign targeting PCOS and postpartum personas absorbed all paid budget this period.

signals.headline: Daily spend averaged $13.63
signals.detail: Well below the $30/day threshold many studios use for stable Facebook lead volume.

signals.headline: Latest day spend dropped to $3.85
signals.detail: Sharp decline from the period average suggests a pacing issue or campaign nearing exhaustion.

signals.headline: Zero leads or conversions reported
signals.detail: No CRM, lead, or booking data flowing in — cannot confirm whether spend produced any pipeline.

signals.headline: 0 organic or local signals tracked
signals.detail: Google Business Profile and social channels have no reporting connected, hiding a major share of studio demand.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Boutique and premium studios typically pay $25–$50 per Facebook lead in 2026, versus $8–$15 for budget gyms. Fitness holds the highest conversion rate on the platform at roughly 14%.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Summer ad costs peaked in July
seasonal.body: Fitness ad costs per thousand impressions hit a yearly high of $29.68 in July 2026, up 44% from June. August traditionally cools before the September back-to-routine surge.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Studios lean into Pilates and community
competitor.body: Pilates now represents over 43% of primary studio modalities. Boutique competitors are shifting budgets from acquisition toward retention, community content, and hybrid low-impact formats.

recommendations.title: Connect lead and booking data to the campaign
recommendations.detail: Consider wiring the PCOS and Postpartum campaign to your CRM or booking tool. Without leads reported, you cannot tell if $2,330 produced results.

recommendations.title: Test a steadier daily budget floor
recommendations.detail: Worth exploring a consistent $25–$30 daily spend. Latest-day drop to $3.85 starves the algorithm and hurts lead volume for boutique studios.

recommendations.title: Add a low-barrier trial offer for the persona
recommendations.detail: Test a free intro class or postpartum consult. Low-barrier offers lift fitness conversion rates and help justify the higher lead cost of niche targeting.
